const p = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Cabinet episode controller. All commands are incremental; no reset is used."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+
+def save_view(res, label):
+    for name, frame in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'{label}_{name}.png')
+    (OUT / f'{label}_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('command', choices=['inspect', 'hold', 'pose'])
+    parser.add_argument('--steps', type=int, default=10)
+    parser.add_argument('--label', default='view')
+    parser.add_argument('--pose', default='')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+    if args.command == 'inspect':
+        res = robot.get_obs(video='none')
+    else:
+        if args.command == 'hold':
+            res = robot.get_obs(seconds=args.steps * spec['control_dt'], video='none')
+        else:
+            targets = np.array(json.loads(args.pose), dtype=float)
+            if targets.shape != (61,):
+                raise ValueError(f'Expected 61 targets, got {targets.shape}')
+            res = robot.submit('joint_position', np.tile(targets, (args.steps, 1)),
+                               dt=spec['control_dt'], video='none', note=args.label)
+    save_view(res, args.label)
+    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in res.meta.items() if k != 'proprio'}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch";
